parts.question: renal dosing guidance for moderate impairment and hepatic monitoring

result.answer:
For moderate renal impairment in Germany, the starting dose for AX-17 is 25 mg OD, with a maximum dose of 50 mg/day [E2]. This applies to patients with an eGFR of 30-59 [E2]. Monitoring requires rechecking in 2-4 weeks [E2]. The approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment is not changed by the safety bulletin [E1].

Regarding hepatic monitoring, baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1].
